title: Turning Red
about: A thirteen-year-old in Toronto turns into a giant red panda whenever she gets too excited.
cue: Serve the mains when the Lee family sits down to dinner.
faces: The red moon ritual at the temple

600g chicken thigh into bite-size pieces and marinate 30 minutes with 1 tbsp soy, 1 tsp five spice, 2 grated garlic cloves and 1 tsp sugar.Toss in 100g sweet potato flour or cornflour.Fry at 180°C for
